name: opencloud-mcp
description: Your OpenCloud files for the model: read, search, write and share them, always as you.
long_description:
Connects Claude to [OpenCloud](https://opencloud.eu). The model reads documents (markdown, text, CSV, PDF) and single sections of them, searches with OpenCloud's own search, writes text files, copies, moves and deletes, brings back what is in the trash and earlier versions, shares with people and by links, tags and marks favorites.

Every request goes to your OpenCloud as you, with your permissions and nothing more. The server keeps no copy of your data.

You need an app token: in OpenCloud, open your account and create one under *App Tokens*.
